title: dwg2geo: fail-closed, provenance-tracking conversion of DWG engineering drawings to GeoJSON
description: dwg2geo converts AutoCAD DWG engineering drawings to GeoJSON with two design commitments. It fails closed: georeferenced output is produced only when the source coordinate reference system is stated explicitly, and local-coordinate output only on explicit opt-in. And it is auditable: output is byte-deterministic for a given input and option set, and every conversion emits a machine-readable provenance record capturing the input digest, dependency versions, options and warnings. One Rust core is exposed as a command-line tool, a WebAssembly module, a Python extension and an R package (maintained in the companion repository milkway/dwg2geo-r). Documentation: milkway.github.io/dwg2geo.
